newsitem.title: USA: Casino Magic to sell Crescent riverboat.
newsitem.headline: Casino Magic to sell Crescent riverboat.

text.p: Casino Magic Corp said on Wednesday that it had agreed to sell the Crescent City Queen riverboat to an unnamed California-based private development company for $12,250,000.
The Crescent City Queen was acquired by Casino Magic in March 1996, along with the acquisition of Crescent City Capital Development Corp.

The Louisiana gaming license which was then held by Crescent City Capital Development Corp was moved by Casino Magic to permit the development of its Bossier City, Louisiana casino which opened in October 1996.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to develop the Bossier City property, Casino Magic said.
The sale is subject to certain conditions precedent, including approval of the transfer from the Louisiana Gaming Commission, but is expected to close this month, Casino Magic said.
